turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My kidney numbers were in the portal.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Your creatinine is 1.3, up from 1.1 last year.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: It is a small change. Drink more water and avoid ibuprofen.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take ibuprofen for my shoulder sometimes.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Use acetaminophen instead and we will recheck in two months.
